incident_spec.summary: Lock wait timeout exceeded during DELETE query execution on a table with frequent concurrent operations.
incident_spec.mechanism: Concurrent transactions holding locks on rows or indexes prevent DELETE operations from acquiring necessary locks within the timeout period.
